name: akbun-thinking
description: Thinking principle skills — let evidence lead the conclusion instead of fitting evidence to a preset answer, and read others' words by their most charitable interpretation

interface.shortDescription: Short thinking principles: evidence-first reasoning and charitable interpretation
interface.longDescription: A collection of one- or two-sentence thinking principles applied while reasoning — let the evidence lead the conclusion rather than fitting it to a preset answer, and interpret others' words in their most reasonable sense before judging them.
defaultPrompt: 정해 둔 답 없이 증거부터 모아서 이 장애 원인을 따져줘 (akbun-thinking-holmes)
이 리뷰 코멘트를 가장 선의로 해석하면 무슨 뜻일까? (akbun-thinking-dennett)
